# webtables/or

> Logical or: `||`, short-circuiting, with a typed `if`.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
(if (result i64) (i64.ne
{left}
(i64.const 0)) (then (i64.const 1)) (else
```
